mission.goal: Deliver a separate durable, read-only owner-intent audit foundation without granting effect or owner authority.
mission.user: Formation-governed EvidenceOps operator requiring zero manual setup and zero new recurring cost.
mission.workflow: validate a hash/reference-only request against a configured complete request/action allowlist, enqueue idempotently, claim with a fenced lease, evaluate closed-enum deterministic policy, optionally validate a data-only advisory receipt, recompute before commit with stop and ledger readback, then independently recompute semantics
mission.data: canonical generic mission metadata, SHA-256 complete request/action bindings, value-suppressed action metadata, local SQLite task state, mission-version floors, hash-chained events, delivered-output occurrences and generic structured learning incidents
mission.interface: local Python API and explicit-path command-line interface
mission.environment: local single-host verification only; no cloud or provider runtime
mission.governance: Formation-governed; negative-only SIG authority; OIFA review; MODISA Code-Forge v3.3
mission.failure: fail closed on stale sources, stop, fencing, policy, schema, secret-like, semantic and authority defects
mission.testing: failure-first unit, integration, adversarial, static-boundary and semantic-readback verification
mission.deployment: not authorised, not configured and not performed
mission.continuity: SQLite idempotency, configured complete request/action allowlists, version-independent active stops, persisted mission-version floors, leases, fencing, retry/dead letter, heartbeats, output ledger, event chain, governed incident learning and handoff files

assumptions.stack: Python 3.12 standard library; no third-party runtime dependencies
assumptions.runtime: one local worker process or bounded one-shot invocations on a single host
assumptions.storage: one explicit local SQLite file using WAL and BEGIN IMMEDIATE
assumptions.authentication: no remote interface; configured request/resume registries are exact local allowlists rather than authenticated issuer or signature proof; worker and boot IDs are liveness identifiers, not owner authority
assumptions.deployment: not deployed; future runtime integration requires a separate mission, Formation permit and live proof

components.frontend: N/A: local CLI only; no browser or remote UI
components.backend: closed-enum deterministic policy engine and worker accepting only data-only advisory receipts
components.database: separate sig_* SQLite schema with transactional claims and hash chains
components.queue: SQLite task table with idempotency, availability and terminal states
components.worker: explicit worker/boot identity, one-shot execution, heartbeat and fenced completion
components.scheduler: not deployed; external invocation is a future separately proven boundary
components.cache: N/A: no cache; canonical database state is authoritative
components.storage: local SQLite database; runtime files excluded from version control
components.authentication: local-only configured allowlists for request/action and stop-resume records; external issuer authentication, signatures and expiry validation are not implemented or claimed

observability.correlation_ids: task UUID, idempotency key, mission/version, worker/boot ID and fence generation
observability.health_checks: schema, state counts, control generation, active stops, last heartbeat, event chain and output-ledger integrity
observability.structured_logs: no raw log sink; bounded structured CLI JSON and database reason codes only
observability.audit_logs: append-only SHA-256 event chain atomically written with transitions
observability.metrics_alerts: local health exposes dead-letter counts, active stops and heartbeat state; no external alert route is configured

testing.unit: contracts, canonicalization, closed-enum verdicts, cost/burden, configured complete request/action bindings, closed state/proof claims and advisory-receipt validation
testing.integration: SQLite enqueue, claim, fencing, version-independent stop/resume, persistent version floors, heartbeat, retries, dead letters, ledgers and semantic readback
testing.e2e_or_smoke: initialize, enqueue, run one local worker, complete a read-only audit and verify semantic receipt
testing.fixtures_mocks: synthetic hashes, generic mission IDs and immutable advisory receipt values only; no executable providers
testing.failure_first: unknown effects and maturity aliases, delete-resource bypass, self-asserted or action-unbound attestations, active-stop version bypass, stale post-resume re-entry, forged completion, secret-shaped and credential-name-shaped identifier or reason metadata, untyped transient flags, raw-advisory persistence, false health, callable provider injection, expired/ABA leases, retry denial and chain tampering

setup_commands: No dependency installation required; use Python 3.12 standard library.
deploy_commands: NOT_AUTHORISED: no deployment command exists in this foundation.
rollback_commands: Stop the local worker, preserve the database for audit, and remove only the isolated draft branch after separate authorisation.
delivery.debugging: Inspect local status/readback JSON and safe reason codes; never persist stack traces, raw advisory bodies, evidence or credentials. Fingerprint every reproduced defect and patch the smallest governed control.

formation.effectful_permit: single-use A1 implementation permit consumed; commit, publication, merge and deployment excluded

continuity.idempotency: unique key plus canonical request hash; same payload joins, different payload conflicts
continuity.checkpoints: hash-chained task events, task state, delivered-output ledger, immutable semantic receipt and deterministically fingerprinted structured learning incidents
continuity.resume_conditions: typed transient retry only; stop clearing requires expected generation, newer mission version and an exact configured resume record, terminally quarantines older matching tasks and persists a minimum accepted version
continuity.stop_switch: active global, mission and requirement latches block all matching versions, increment the global control generation, fence all older leases and persist per-scope minimum-version floors on clear

proof.test_results: 51 focused guardian tests passed after repeated independent red-team waves, including active-stop version blocking, persistent version floors, complete request/action attestations, closed state/proof vocabularies, credential-name and secret-value identifier screening, closed reason codes, typed retry classification, raw advisory rejection and evidence-bound learning validation; repository-wide retest, fresh frozen-source review and exact-head CI remain publication gates.
proof.semantic_verification: local end-to-end task completed with SEMANTIC_READBACK_VERIFIED after request/result hashes, output ledger, event chain and deterministic policy recomputation matched.
